beforeShellExecution.command: bash -c 'r=$1; case $r in [A-Za-z]:*) if command -v wslpath >/dev/null 2>&1; then r=$(wslpath -u "$r"); elif command -v cygpath >/dev/null 2>&1; then r=$(cygpath -u "$r"); else d=$(printf %s "$r" | cut -c1 | tr A-Z a-z); rest=${r:2}; rest=${rest//\\//}; r=/mnt/$d$rest; fi;; esac; exec bash "$r/hooks/guard-shell.sh"' _ '${CURSOR_PLUGIN_ROOT}'

afterFileEdit.command: bash -c 'r=$1; case $r in [A-Za-z]:*) if command -v wslpath >/dev/null 2>&1; then r=$(wslpath -u "$r"); elif command -v cygpath >/dev/null 2>&1; then r=$(cygpath -u "$r"); else d=$(printf %s "$r" | cut -c1 | tr A-Z a-z); rest=${r:2}; rest=${rest//\\//}; r=/mnt/$d$rest; fi;; esac; exec bash "$r/hooks/post-edit-lint.sh"' _ '${CURSOR_PLUGIN_ROOT}'
